correctness.rationale: For odd primes p and n>=2, smooth normalization has exactly two Fp-rational off-affine places (one additional above u=0, one totally ramified at infinity). Over Fp, (u+1)v=B(u); the exceptional u=-1 fiber contributes p iff p|2n+1 and p=3 mod4. Over Fp², the linear map v->uv^p+v is invertible if N(u)!=1; norm-one fibers split by u^((p+1)/2)=±1 and their image condition gives N1=p+1+p delta epsilon and N2=p²+1+p(p-1)delta/2. The zeta coefficients follow via Newton identities. Independent Fp² arithmetic verified eight pairs, including both delta regimes; finite examples are not universal proof.
